commit c0950144a6c84a7948fa49c0757d14a9bc0155c2
Author:     Justin Tracey <jtracey@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Wed Nov 5 00:37:02 2025 +0000
Commit:     Justin Tracey <jtracey@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Wed Nov 5 00:37:02 2025 +0000

    Bug 1998299 - Update macOS SDK to 26.1. r=darktrojan
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D271322

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/libotr.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/libotr.yml
index a334e0c853d..b0b246a5fac 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/libotr.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/libotr.yml
@@ -44,7 +44,7 @@ macosx64-x64-libotr:
         symbol: TM(libotr)
     worker:
         env:
-            MACOS_SDK_DIR: "MacOSX26.0.sdk"
+            MACOS_SDK_DIR: "MacOSX26.1.sdk"
             MACOS_TARGET_SDK: "10.15"
     run:
         arguments: ['macosx64']
@@ -60,7 +60,7 @@ macosx64-aarch64-libotr:
         symbol: TMA64(libotr)
     worker:
         env:
-            MACOS_SDK_DIR: "MacOSX26.0.sdk"
+            MACOS_SDK_DIR: "MacOSX26.1.sdk"
             MACOS_TARGET_SDK: "11.0"
     run:
         arguments: ['macosx64-aarch64']
diff --git a/taskcluster/scripts/build-libotr.sh b/taskcluster/scripts/build-libotr.sh
index db3abaa63c9..a076a3e9dd5 100755
--- a/taskcluster/scripts/build-libotr.sh
+++ b/taskcluster/scripts/build-libotr.sh
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@ GECKO_PATH=${GECKO_PATH:-"/builds/worker/workspace/build/src"}
 MOZ_FETCHES_DIR=${MOZ_FETCHES_DIR:-"/builds/worker/fetches"}
 UPLOAD_DIR=${UPLOAD_DIR:-"/builds/worker/artifacts"}
 WORKSPACE=${WORKSPACE:-"${HOME}/workspace"}
-MACOS_SDK_DIR=${MACOS_SDK_DIR:-"MacOSX26.0.sdk"}
+MACOS_SDK_DIR=${MACOS_SDK_DIR:-"MacOSX26.1.sdk"}
 MACOS_TARGET_SDK=${MACOS_TARGET_SDK:-"10.15"}
title: Bug 1998299 - Update macOS SDK to 26.1. r=darktrojan
